label: Evidence-16
title: CrowdStrike dates each flaw's code: CVE-2026-109618 from PHP 7.3.0 (2018), CVE-2026-109619 back to 5.4 (session path) and 7.1 (serialization)
description: Found through Greenbone's posts on oss-security (2026/10/23/4 and /5, now references in both CVE records). The first claim that splits the two flaws by version. If it holds, 'all versions from 5.4' is true only of CVE-2026-109619. The page contradicts itself ('present in every PHP release from the 7.x and 8.x series'). Capture it; then versions-old and the version table on /patching/ should be re-graded.

properties.excerpt: The specific HashTable ordering behind CVE-2026-109618 was introduced by a performance optimization in October 2017 and first shipped in PHP 7.3.0
